name: Open Opportunities by Rep
query:
SELECT
    u.full_name AS Opportunity_Owner_Full_Name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Beginning Stages' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as beginning_stages,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Active Dialogue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_dialogue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Pending Contract' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_contract,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Contract Sent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as contract_sent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Redline/PO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as redline_po,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Closed Won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as closed_won,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Closed Lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as closed_lost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Prospecting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as prospecting,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.sales_stage = 'Discovery' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as discovery
FROM
    `tabOpportunity` o
JOIN
    `tabUser` u ON o.opportunity_owner = u.email
GROUP BY
    Opportunity_Owner_Full_Name
HAVING
    beginning_stages + active_dialogue + pending_contract +
    contract_sent + redline_po + closed_won + closed_lost +
    prospecting + discovery > 0;
